detail.longDescription: Accenture Contractor Reportedly Allowed Claude AI Agent Entry to Protected Pentagon Network # internet # cybersecurity # artificialintelligence A report alleges an Accenture contractor gave a personal Claude AI agent admin access to a Pentagon network, potentially exposing credentials and network details.
